name: Fade Content
description: Wrapper that reveals its children with a fade, focus, develop, or noise-mask dissolve effect when scrolled into view, on mount, or scrubbed with scroll, with optional stagger and exit.
contents: A single wrapper div around any children, hidden until revealed
Optional per-child stagger when stagger is above 0
behavior: Reveals on scroll entry through GSAP ScrollTrigger, or immediately when trigger is mount
Scrub mode ties reveal progress to scroll position, with optional smoothing and exit fade
Can reverse when leaving, replay when scrolling back, or disappear after a set time
Noise effects use an SVG turbulence filter mask that is removed after the reveal
Skips animation and shows content when reduced motion is preferred
editableByProps: Reveal style, blur amount, duration, ease, delay, and start opacity
Trigger mode, scroll threshold, scroll container, once, exit, and scrub
Stagger timing and direction, auto disappear timing
Lifecycle callbacks, className, style, and extra div attributes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the default scroll container id
needsCodeEdit.where: snap-main-container lookup at the start of the layout effect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the noise mask softness or pixel size

fixed: Wrapper starts with the invisible class and is made visible by the effect, so Tailwind must be present
Without a container prop it uses the element with id snap-main-container as scroller if present, otherwise the window
Noise effects (dissolve, mist, pixel) append a hidden SVG to document.body while active
Durations and delays above 10 are treated as milliseconds
Disappear only works when once is true, exit is false, and scrub is off
Scrub is ignored when trigger is mount
Works at all screen sizes since it only wraps content, layout is up to the children
